# Changes that newly fail

© 2026 Casey Houle. All rights reserved.
ENGINE-OWNED: local edits to this file are discarded on update

Each harness release names here what a project that passed before may fail
after updating (spec 06 REQ-6.6). An update that silently turns a project's
gates red is indistinguishable from a regression in the project.

## 0.1.0

First release. Everything is new; nothing passed before.
